name: flow_race_party_of_four_regroups
description: A full Tide Race party of four (design 5.2: 'click a row to change team') can still regroup: at two a side every row moves, the leader's click on one sends it to the other team (three against one: Start waits for two teams of one size), and a click on a row of the larger team brings the teams back to two a side with two players swapped. A duel's rule that no row moves onto a side already taken is the duel's only (flow_duel_party_two_sides).

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').lines() == ['A diamond Sascha lamplighter leader', 'A circle Ben lamplighter', 'B triangle Ana lookout', 'B square Cy beekeeper']
steps.msg: two a side: Sascha and Ben on A, Ana and Cy on B
two a side in a race: every row may move

steps.assert: tips == ['Click to move to the other team', 'Click to move to the other team', 'Click to move to the other team', 'Click to move to the other team']
node('HubPanel').lines() == ['A diamond Sascha lamplighter leader', 'B circle Ana lookout', 'B triangle Ben lamplighter', 'B square Cy beekeeper']
steps.msg: the click moved Ben to B: three against one (team B's rows by row: Ana, Ben, Cy)

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').primary_text() == 'Start' and node('Primary').disabled and node('PrimaryLine').text == 'Two teams of one size: click a row to move it'
steps.msg: three against one: Start waits for two teams of one size

steps.assert: node('Member2').tooltip_text == 'Click to move to the other team' and Session.can_move(1)
steps.msg: Ana's row, second now, moves onto the team of one

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').lines() == ['A diamond Sascha lamplighter leader', 'A circle Ana lookout', 'B triangle Ben lamplighter', 'B square Cy beekeeper']
steps.msg: two a side again, Ana and Ben swapped
